_note: Metadata only; the images are vendor material and are NOT in this repository (they live in the create-legacy-firmware archive under firmware-history/<tag>/, see historyPath). Built by tools/build_firmware_catalog.py from every NayaFlow release 0.0.1 to 1.25.1; do not hand-edit. One entry per DISTINCT image (deduplicated by plaintextSha256, by blobSha256 for the LittleFS module bundle); `bundles` lists every release that shipped it, `bundle` the newest. Filenames repeat across releases (every one has a kb_fwl.bin), so match a file by blobSha256, never by name. Keyboard: plaintextSha256 is what `mcumgr image list` reports for the running image; `generation` is the QSPI flash generation NayaCore picks by USB PID and a half matches exactly one image. `createFirmware` / `moduleFirmware` come from the release changelogs ("NayaCreate (vA -> vB)") or the 1.25.x app JS; where no release declared a number, versionConfidence is "unknown" and versionLabel names the release(s) instead. `releaseOrder` is the chronological index of the first release that shipped the image, for the downgrade guard when versions are unknown. Module: FlashMemory.bin is a LittleFS bundle; its `moduleFirmware` is the VERSION file inside it (what MODULE_FILE_FW_VERSION reports) and `contents` lists its userapps with the SHA-256 the Create reports for each (the bundle's _HASH sidecars); the .sfb entries repeat that per app, `containerBlobSha256` naming their bundle.

withheldBecause: pre-production image: the 0.0.x releases (March 2025) targeted Batch 1 / DVT#2 units and predate the kb_fw naming, the dial and the module bus. Compatibility with production units is unknown, so it is catalogued for identification only
